requirements.title: Installation one-click
requirements.acceptance: One .mcaddon opens with Minecraft and imports both packs without manual ZIP handling.
evidence: C-007 Android field result: v0.4 one-click mcaddon imported correctly.

requirements.title: Visible identifiable item
requirements.acceptance: Search by vehicle name returns an item with a visible recognizable icon; placement works without cheats.
evidence: Creative registration works; v0.4 icon failed visually; v0.5 contains mapped PNG but device render not yet proven.

requirements.title: Vehicle controls
requirements.acceptance: Player can mount, steer and move using mobile controls without horse/taming UX.
evidence: Horse/taming components absent statically; mobile steering observed in earlier field builds.

requirements.title: Driver visibility
requirements.acceptance: Default driving view exposes useful forward and lateral environment; cabin does not dominate the screen.
evidence: v0.4 Android screenshots show cabin/geometry still obstructing view.

requirements.title: 4x4 terrain
requirements.acceptance: Vehicle crosses ordinary 1-block transitions and progressive rough mounds; vertical 2-block walls remain non-traversable.
evidence: v0.5 policy/config allows 1.25-block auto-step; real Android terrain traversal not yet proven.

requirements.title: Reuse before invention
requirements.acceptance: Each major subsystem has a source/adoption review before BUILD_ONLY_IF_GAP.
evidence: Source registry contains integrated MIT template and community reference set.

requirements.title: Provenance
requirements.acceptance: Every reused asset records source, author, license and integration scope.

requirements.title: Semantic anticipations
requirements.acceptance: Every counted anticipation maps to requirement_id + scenario + oracle + expected + evidence class; pure cartesian repetitions are reported separately and do not inflate coverage.

requirements.title: Truthful release gate
requirements.acceptance: READY is forbidden while any P0 is FAIL, PARTIAL or UNTESTED.
evidence: This registry makes v0.5 a CANDIDATE, not READY.
